strategies.max_softmax_argmax_debris: Current class argmax must be Marine Debris and max softmax >= threshold; pixels below max-confidence threshold are abstained/uncertain.
strategies.marine_debris_probability_one_vs_rest: P(Marine Debris) >= threshold regardless of argmax; this is a binary class-specific override and can conflict with the highest-probability non-debris class.

label_policy: 0-valued official masks are unlabeled and excluded from precision/recall/F1/IoU. Predictions on unlabeled or invalid imagery are reported separately and never counted as false positives.
invalid_imagery_policy: Any masked or non-finite input band marks a pixel invalid. The model still receives mean-imputed inputs as local detector does; invalid pixel predictions are excluded from valid-imagery counts and reported separately.

fit.fit_method: bounded scalar minimization of validation multiclass NLL

temperature_scaling.interpretation: Exploratory scalar calibration fitted and scored on the same validation labels; use an independent calibration set or nested validation before deployment.
